name: @muralink/multiuser
description: Enterprise multi-user front for the orchester (shared-workspace model). Authenticates each user and forwards to the ONE shared core stamped with a verified `who` (X-Mural-User). INERT without a valid multi-user entitlement — then it is a transparent pass-through and the instance stays single-user. The paid capability is the authenticated identity the sync protocol needs, not a locked button.
